visual.face: Rostro adulto largo y rectangular, frente alta, cejas marcadas, ojos marrones profundos de tamaño realista, nariz larga prominente con punta redondeada hacia abajo, labios delgados, surcos nasolabiales y mandíbula angulosa estrecha. Foto de 2026 confirma lentes transparentes de marco redondo fino. Evitar cara juvenil de anime.
visual.hair: Corto, oscuro con muchas canas especialmente en las sienes, entradas y frente amplia. La gorra deja asomar patillas y canas; no se inventó una melena abundante.
visual.outfit: Gorra tricolor documentada en archivo y crónicas, adaptada con frente azul/estrellas blancas, panel amarillo/rojo y visera azul. Chaqueta abierta azul marino, polo blanco y jeans azules vistos en enero de 2026. Zapatillas blancas son continuación artística del traje de combate; la foto de oficina no muestra los pies.

sprite.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2D fighting-game animation atlas for Arena Criolla.
Primary request: REBUILD Henrique Capriles Radonski as a recognizable editorial caricature from the real photographs, with exactly EIGHT separate full-body poses, arranged FOUR columns by TWO rows on a 2048x1024 landscape canvas.

Input image roles:
Image 1 (press conference, January 2026): PRIMARY facial identity reference. Copy THIS mature man's recognizable head, nose, eyes, ears and age.
Image 2 (office portrait, January 2026): secondary face, hair, actual adult build and wardrobe reference.
Image 3 (airport 2012): reference ONLY for the iconic Venezuelan tricolor baseball cap, and confirmation of his characteristic long projecting nose. Do not revert to his younger face.
Image 4 (old Delsa sprite sheet): reference ONLY for ink outlines, cel shading and readable arcade illustration style; NOT identity.

Subject: Henrique Capriles in his early/mid 50s, tall slim adult man with narrow elongated rectangular face, high broad forehead, deep-set brown eyes with realistic small irises, heavy dark slightly graying eyebrows, substantial long projecting nose with a rounded downward tip, pronounced nasolabial creases, thin uneven lips, clearly drawn mature cheeks, visible ears, firm narrow angular jaw. Clean shaven with faint gray stubble. Short dark-gray hair with gray temples and a receding hairline visible at the sides under his cap. Transparent round thin-rim eyeglasses, eyes clearly visible. Make the facial features slightly enlarged for likeness. Preserve age and distinctive facial proportions in EVERY pose.
Outfit in every pose: Venezuelan yellow-blue-red tricolor baseball cap with small white stars across blue front and blue curved bill; dark navy open windbreaker with collar, white short-sleeve polo shirt visible beneath, medium blue straight slim jeans, white running sneakers. Outfit follows the real recent office photograph, cap follows archive photo. No brand lettering or logos.
Style: expressive Venezuelan editorial caricature, polished arcade cel-shaded illustration, bold dark ink contours, restrained adult anatomy. Detailed faces that genuinely resemble the photographed Capriles, never a handsome young anime hero. Athletic but lean everyday human build, no superhero muscles.

Composition: EXACTLY 8 whole connected bodies, one per cell, four equal columns and two equal rows. All characters face screen RIGHT in consistent three-quarter profile. Use identical identity, clothing, head size and body scale throughout. Each full body, including cap, glasses, fingers and both shoes, is wholly inside its own cell with generous transparent gutters and at least 30 pixels outer padding. Keep every limb connected to its own torso. Never touch another pose. Leave blank padding above and below both rows. Grounded feet at a shared baseline within each row.
Top row left to right: (1) ready idle with fists up, (2) defensive block with crossed forearms, (3) running RIGHT with LEFT leg forward, (4) running RIGHT with RIGHT leg forward, visibly opposite stride from pose 3.
Bottom row left to right: (5) jumping with BOTH knees tucked, (6) straight rightward right-handed punch, (7) high side kick toward the RIGHT with other foot planted, (8) recoiling BACKWARD from a hit while still facing right.

Background: TRUE alpha transparency everywhere outside silhouettes. Absolutely no colored or checkered backdrop, ground, floor, cast shadows, cell boundaries, panels, text, labels, watermarks, detached objects, microphone, motion effects, particles, action lines, trails, extra limbs, extra people, overlapping sprites or cropped extremities. Exactly eight separate connected silhouettes with spacious transparent separation.
sprite.styleReference: assets/source/delsa.png, sólo estilo de contornos y cel shading
sprite.postprocess: Relocación sin pérdida y sin reescalado de las ocho siluetas completas sobre un lienzo transparente 2048×1024. Mismo dibujo y alfa generados. Se añadió margen al atlas; no se redibujaron rostros ni miembros.

validation.method: BFS de vecinos 4, idéntico criterio del cargador src/game/assets.ts
validation.visualReview: PNG generado y WebP final vistos. Se aprecian rostro adulto, nariz característica, lentes, mismo traje en ocho poses; sin cuerpos cortados ni efectos externos.
validation.loaderNote: El cargador compartido ya alinea cada pose terrestre por sus píxeles inferiores y conserva la altura del salto. No se modificó código compartido.

limitations: La vestimenta combina la ropa real del retrato de enero de 2026 con la gorra icónica del archivo de 2012; no afirma copiar un único conjunto fotografiado.
La gorra cubre gran parte de la línea del pelo, pero se mantienen sienes oscuras/grises y rostro maduro.
Las dos poses de carrera difieren en brazos y torso; las piernas dibujadas tienen siluetas cercanas.
No se entregó un sample de voz original porque no se pudo escuchar y verificar el interlocutor, timestamp y transcripción.
Las fotografías periodísticas son referencias de investigación; el sprite es una caricatura original generada.
